messages.subject: shinyapps deployment keeps redeploying
parts:

messages.author: 7df74fd07a628732
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps deployment keeps redeploying
parts:
Hi,

I managed to debug this too. Turns out having my credentials at the top of the page kept sending it back into the server to be deployed! Getting rid of this and clicking the manual deploy button in RStudio did the trick for me. Sorry to annoy!
